bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} as a control surface?

user.description: Pick a BLE MIDI controller that is switched on and in range.

abort.no_devices_found: No BLE MIDI controller was found. Switch it on, make sure nothing else is connected to it, and try again.

midi_needs_status_byte.message: MIDI must begin with a status byte, which is 0x80 or higher. Got {first}.

no_target_device.message: Pick which M-Vave device to send to, under Targets.

unknown_page.message: This surface has no page called {page}. It has: {pages}.

surface_not_ready.message: The surface on {address} is not running yet. It builds itself once the device connects and has been read.

navigate.name: Go to page
navigate.description: Send a control surface to one of its pages. The grid animates as if it had been pressed, but without a spiral, because nobody pressed anything.

page.name: Page
page.description: The page to show. For a room page this is the area's id.

focus.name: Point the knobs at an entity
focus.description: Choose what the encoders adjust, without anybody holding a pad. Stays until something else takes it or the page changes.

home.name: Go home
home.description: Clear a control surface's navigation history back to its root page.

send_raw.name: Send raw MIDI
send_raw.description: Send MIDI bytes straight to the device. The escape hatch for anything the pages and the knobs do not model.

data.name: Data
data.description: Hex bytes, spaced however you like. Must begin with a status byte, for example 99 24 05 to light pad 1 green.

press_slot.name: Press a pad
press_slot.description: Press one of the sixteen pads as though a finger had. The pad is a position, not a thing: it does whatever is on that position of the page showing at the time. To act on one particular light, call that light's own action instead.

slot.name: Pad
slot.description: Which pad, counted from one, reading order: 1 is the top left and 16 is the bottom right.

action.name: Press or hold
action.description: A press does the pad's usual thing. A hold does what holding it does, which for a light is to point the knobs at it.

get_pages.name: What the pads mean
get_pages.description: Return every page and what is on each of its sixteen pads, resolved as it stands right now. Nothing is written on this device, and a room page fills itself from whatever is in the room, so this is the only way to find out what a pad will do without walking over and pressing it.

page.name: Page
page.description: Just this one page. Leave it empty for all of them. For a room page this is the area's id.

init.title: Rooms
init.description: Pick the rooms that get a page, in the order they should appear on the grid's first screen. Everything in a room fills its page on its own, so there is nothing else to set up.

page_colours.title: Room colours
page_colours.description:
A colour for each room. It appears on the first screen and again as the curtain that sweeps across when you go in and out.

There are five because five is how many this device can show that anybody can tell apart from across a room. Past the fifth they repeat, and position on the first screen tells them apart instead.

domain_colours.title: What things look like
domain_colours.description:
A colour for each kind of thing, the same in every room.

A pad shows its colour when the thing behind it is on, and white when it is off. That is the one rule the grid cannot bend, so white is not on offer.

Purple is safe only on scenes. Scenes have no on and off, so they never show white, and purple is the one colour that is hard to tell from it.
